model.name: Re-key home-copy must be HOME-ISOLATED — no cross-home symlink injection (R40.22 re-key BLOCKER)
model.description: The R40.22 storage re-key single-window --apply (copy all 47 data/users/<token> homes -> data/users/<storageId>) must be HOME-ISOLATED: each copied home contains EXACTLY its own source's contents. MEASURED DEFECT (expert, on scratch): one home ce981242's copy gained an EXTRA room dir 68d0f039 (files/ = symlinks -> scenario/index) that is NOT in that home's own source -> copy had 70 in-home symlinks vs 69 in the original = cross-home copy-contamination. The architect's COUNT-MIRROR gate (assert copy-symlink-count == source-symlink-count) caught it (70!=69 -> VERIFY FAILED -> --apply self-ABORTED, originals byte-untouched); delta-broken + content-multiset were BLIND (extra symlinks RESOLVE so delta-broken=0; multiset EXCLUDES symlinks). R40.22 re-key is PARKED on this until root-caused. PROD SAFE + INERT + gate-protected; step-3 116-token auth-invalidation DONE + armed.

model.crossRefNote: BLOCKS R40.22 acbfe6e7 (storage/identity re-key); crossRef R40.21 1c3b86ad (credentials-as-capability). The count-mirror gate that caught this is the architect's; keep it load-bearing in the re-key verify (delta+multiset alone would have shipped a contaminated copy).

acceptanceCriteria.text: The re-key home-copy is HOME-ISOLATED: a copied home contains EXACTLY its own source's contents — NO cross-home symlink/dir injection. The observed defect (ce981242's copy gained room dir 68d0f039 not in its source; 70 in-home symlinks vs 69) must not recur.

The COUNT-MIRROR gate (copy-symlink-count == source-symlink-count per home) stays LOAD-BEARING in the re-key verify — it is the ONLY check that caught this (delta-broken=0 because the extra symlinks resolve; content-multiset excludes symlinks). A verify without count-mirror would ship a contaminated copy.

ROOT-CAUSED before resume: reproduce in an ISOLATED SAME-FILESYSTEM root WITH scenario/index PRESENT (a /tmp root WITHOUT scenario MASKS it — that flawed test gave a false green earlier), then BISECT which OTHER home injects 68d0f039 into ce981242 + the exact tar/symlink mechanism that fires ONLY when the symlink target resolves.

MEASURED rule-in/out (recorded so the bisection does not re-walk them): (a) tokenToStorageId is INJECTIVE 47->47 distinct, 0 dup, 0 sid==token = NOT a mapping collision; (b) the +1 appears ONLY when scenario/index is PRESENT (symlink targets resolve) — WITHOUT it the copy is faithful 69; (c) 68d0f039 is NOT in ce981242's source tar = a CROSS-HOME injection in the full multi-home flow; (d) NOT the copy primitive (cp -rP, tar-pipe, AND stage-then-move all reproduce 70).

R40.22 re-key resumes ONLY after root-cause + a full SCRATCH-GREEN (count-mirror 69==69 + delta 0 + content-multiset f1761782 + 84 rewrites + no-token-path) + architect review. Until then re-key stays PARKED; prod stays SAFE/INERT/gate-protected.
